verdict: Leads arriving, but cost per lead is rising and pipeline is empty.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 175 leads from Meta at an average cost of $12.07 per lead — still well below your historical ceiling, but the trend moved the wrong way this week: leads dropped 16.33% and cost per lead rose 11.51% compared to the prior 7 days, with ad spend roughly flat, meaning the ads are delivering fewer results for the same budget. Instagram reach fell 21% in the same window, which is contributing to the reduced efficiency. The more pressing issue is what happens after a lead arrives: your CRM shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments set in the last 28 days, meaning none of the incoming leads have moved into your pipeline. We are prioritizing the automation and CRM setup items needed to close that gap so leads start converting to cases.

average cost per lead this period, up 11.51% in the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but none are entering the pipeline — CRM automation, SMS follow-up, and voice access are not yet live, leaving incoming leads without an automated response path.
watch_item.fix: These items are being actioned now; once live, incoming leads will be automatically logged, messaged, and queued for follow-up, which should begin moving the pipeline number off zero.
